settings.subtitle: We aim to deliver your orders quickly and safely with a smooth shopping experience.
settings.item_1_text: All orders are processed within 1–2 business days after confirmation.
settings.item_2_text: Orders are usually delivered within 3–7 business days depending on your location.
settings.item_3_text: Shipping charges may vary based on your location and order value. Free shipping may be available on selected products or offers.
settings.item_4_text: Cash on Delivery is available on selected products and locations.
settings.item_5_text: Once your order is shipped, you will receive a tracking link via SMS or email to track your order.
settings.item_6_text: Delivery may be delayed due to unforeseen circumstances such as weather conditions, holidays, or logistics issues.
settings.item_7_text: Please ensure that your shipping details are correct. We are not responsible for delays or losses due to incorrect addresses.
settings.footer_text: If you have any questions about your order, feel free to contact our support team.
